howto.what: Claude 会按统一分类（验证、认证、未找到、冲突、意外）整理错误，并确保每条错误只记录一次，响应映射清晰。
howto.when: 当你要求标准化 API 错误处理、统一日志策略，或使用 Result/Either 模式时触发。

say.text: 帮我给这个 API 加上统一的错误分类和日志规则。

say.text: 用 Result 模式重构这里的错误处理。

howto.what_en: Claude will categorize errors by validation, auth, not_found, conflict, and unexpected, enforce a log-once rule, and define explicit response mappings.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to standardize API error handling, unify logging policy, or apply Result/Either patterns.

say_en.text: Add unified error categories and logging rules to this API.
say_en.note: Claude will produce an error catalog and verify steps.

say_en.text: Refactor error handling here using the Result pattern.
say_en.note: Claude will apply Result/Either and ensure no duplicate logs.
